blocks.text: O'zbekchada o'tmishdagi odatni `-ardi` shakli bilan aytamiz: «Bolaligimda har yozni qishloqda o'tkaz**ardim**», «Ilgari bu yerda bozor bo'l**ardi**». Bu gaplarda «endi unday emas» degan ma'no ham bor. Ingliz tilida aynan shu ma'no uchun **used to** + fe'l ishlatiladi: I **used to** spend every summer in the village. **used to** har doim o'tmish haqida va deyarli doim «hozir boshqacha» degan fikrni beradi.

rows: She **used to** work here. — U ilgari shu yerda ishlardi.
She **didn't use to** work here. — U ilgari bu yerda ishlamasdi.
**Did** she **use to** work here? — U shu yerda ishlarmidi?

blocks.text: **used to** barcha egalar bilan bir xil: I / he / they **used to**. Undan keyin fe'l doim lug'at shaklida: used to **go** («used to going» emas). Inkor va savol oddiy Past Simple kabi **did** bilan quriladi (→ 12-dars). Diqqat: **did** dan keyin fe'l o'tgan zamon shaklini yo'qotadi, shuning uchun `-d` tushib qoladi: **didn't use to**, **Did** you **use to** ...? («didn't used to» emas). **used to** ning hozirgi zamon shakli yo'q: «I use to play» deyilmaydi.

items.text: **Did** you **use to** live here? — Yes, I **did**.

blocks.text: **used to** ikki xil narsa haqida gapiradi. Birinchisi — o'tmishda **ko'p marta takrorlangan** harakat, odat: We **used to** play in the street every evening — «Har kuni kechqurun ko'chada o'ynardik». Ikkinchisi — o'tmishda **uzoq davom etgan holat**: live, have, be, know, like kabi fe'llar bilan: My uncle **used to** have a shop — «Amakimning do'koni bor edi». Bunday gaplar o'zbekchaga ko'pincha «ilgari ... edi», «...ardi» deb tarjima qilinadi. Joy haqida: **There used to be** a cinema here — «Bu yerda ilgari kinoteatr bor edi» (there is / there was → 37–38-darslar).

items.text: On Fridays my mother **used to** make samsa.
This hotel **used to** be a palace.

blocks.text: Past Simple (→ 11-dars) har qanday tugagan harakat uchun: bir martalik ham, ko'p martalik ham. **used to** esa faqat **takroriy** odat yoki **uzoq** holat uchun va «endi boshqacha» degan ohangni qo'shadi. Shuning uchun bir martalik voqea yoki aniq necha marta bo'lgani haqida **used to** ishlatilmaydi: «Last year I used to go to London three times» emas, **Last year I went to London three times.** Hozirgi odat uchun esa Present Simple: I usually **walk** to work.

items.text: Aziz **used to** smoke, but he **stopped** two years ago.
items.translation: Aziz ilgari **chekardi**, lekin ikki yil oldin **tashladi**.

items.text: We **used to** live in Manchester. Now we **live** in Oxford.

blocks.text: **be used to** + `-ing` («...ga o'rganib qolgan») va **get used to** («...ga ko'nikmoq») — boshqa iboralar: I'**m used to** getting up early — «Erta turishga o'rganib qolganman». Ularni **used to** + fe'l bilan adashtirmang; bu iboralar keyingi darajada o'tiladi.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I use to play football every day.» (hozir haqida) → **I usually play football every day.**; «I used to going there.» → **I used to go there.**; «Did you used to ...?» → **Did you use to ...?**; «I didn't used to ...» → **I didn't use to ...**; «Yesterday I used to work late.» → **Yesterday I worked late.** (bir martalik voqea).
Eslab qolish: gapga «ilgari» so'zini qo'yib ko'ring. «Ilgari ...ardim, endi yo'q» ma'nosi chiqsa — **used to**. «Kecha», «o'tgan yili bir marta» bo'lsa — oddiy Past Simple.

items: **used to** + fe'l — o'tmishdagi odat yoki holat, endi yo'q: I **used to** live in Bukhara.
Inkor — **didn't use to** + fe'l: He **didn't use to** like tea.
So'roq — **Did** ... **use to** + fe'l?: **Did** you **use to** walk to school? — Yes, I **did**.
Joy haqida — **There used to be** ...: **There used to be** a park here.
Bir martalik voqea — Past Simple; hozirgi odat — Present Simple (**used to** ning hozirgi zamoni yo'q).

examples.title: **used to**: habits in the past
examples.description: O'tmishda ko'p marta takrorlangan odat: **used to** + fe'l = «...ardim», «...ardi». Hozir bu odat yo'q.

sentences.text: When I was a child, I **used to** spend every summer in my grandparents' village.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimda har yozni bobom va buvimning qishlog'ida **o'tkazardim**.

sentences.text: My father **used to** take us fishing on Sundays.
sentences.translation: Dadam yakshanba kunlari bizni baliq oviga **olib borardi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **used to** play football every evening after school.
sentences.translation: Aziz har kuni darsdan keyin kechqurun futbol **o'ynardi**.

sentences.text: We **used to** walk to school together — it took twenty minutes.
sentences.translation: Maktabga birga piyoda **borardik** — yigirma daqiqa vaqt ketardi.

sentences.text: In the 1990s people **used to** write letters by hand.
sentences.translation: 1990-yillarda odamlar xatlarni qo'lda **yozishardi**.

sentences.text: Emma **used to** go to the gym three times a week, but she stopped last year.
sentences.translation: Emma haftasiga uch marta sport zaliga **borardi**, lekin o'tgan yili to'xtatdi.

sentences.text: My grandmother **used to** bake bread in a tandoor every morning.
sentences.translation: Buvim har kuni ertalab tandirda non **yopardi**.

sentences.text: At university Bekzod and I **used to** study in the library until midnight.
sentences.translation: Universitetda Bekzod ikkalamiz kutubxonada yarim tungacha **o'qirdik**.

sentences.text: Tom **used to** drink five cups of coffee a day!
sentences.translation: Tom kuniga besh chashka qahva **ichardi**!

sentences.text: Every New Year our family **used to** watch the same old film on TV.
sentences.translation: Har Yangi yilda oilamiz televizorda bitta eski filmni **ko'rardi**.

examples.title: **used to**: states in the past
examples.description: O'tmishda uzoq davom etgan holat: **used to** + be / have / live / like / know. O'zbekchada ko'pincha «ilgari ... edi», «... bor edi».

sentences.text: We **used to** live in a small flat near the market.
sentences.translation: Ilgari bozor yaqinidagi kichik kvartirada **yashardik**.

sentences.text: Madina **used to** have long hair.
sentences.translation: Madinaning ilgari uzun sochi **bor edi**.

sentences.text: This building **used to** be a cinema.
sentences.translation: Bu bino ilgari kinoteatr **edi**.

sentences.text: I **used to** be very shy at school.
sentences.translation: Maktabda juda **uyatchan edim**.

sentences.text: James **used to** hate vegetables, but he loves them now.
sentences.translation: Jeyms ilgari sabzavotlarni **yomon ko'rardi**, hozir esa juda yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: My uncle **used to** own a small shop in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Amakimning ilgari Samarqandda kichik do'koni **bor edi**.

sentences.text: Our street **used to** be very quiet.
sentences.translation: Ko'chamiz ilgari juda **tinch edi**.

sentences.text: When she was young, Sarah **used to** believe in ghosts.
sentences.translation: Sara yoshligida arvohlarga **ishonardi**.

sentences.text: Before the new road, the trip to the mountains **used to** take four hours.
sentences.translation: Yangi yo'l qurilishidan oldin tog'larga borish to'rt soat **olardi**.

sentences.text: The children **used to** be afraid of our neighbour's dog.
sentences.translation: Bolalar qo'shnimizning itidan **qo'rqishardi**.

examples.title: **used to** ..., **but now** ...
examples.description: O'tmish va hozir yonma-yon: «ilgari ...ardi, endi esa ...». O'tmish — **used to**, hozir — Present Simple yoki be.

sentences.text: I **used to** live in Bukhara, but now I **live** in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Ilgari Buxoroda **yashardim**, hozir esa Toshkentda **yashayman**.

sentences.text: Tom **used to** smoke, but he **doesn't** smoke any more.
sentences.translation: Tom ilgari **chekardi**, endi esa **chekmaydi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **used to** work in a bank; now she **teaches** English.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza ilgari bankda **ishlardi**; hozir ingliz tilidan **dars beradi**.

sentences.text: This café **used to** be cheap, but now it**'s** quite expensive.
sentences.translation: Bu kafe ilgari **arzon edi**, hozir esa ancha **qimmat**.

sentences.text: We **used to** watch TV every evening. Now we **read** or **go** for a walk.
sentences.translation: Ilgari har kuni kechqurun televizor **ko'rardik**. Hozir kitob **o'qiymiz** yoki sayrga **chiqamiz**.

sentences.text: My son **used to** be afraid of the dark, but he**'s** braver now.
sentences.translation: O'g'lim ilgari qorong'idan **qo'rqardi**, hozir esa **jasurroq**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **used to** get up at noon. These days he **starts** work at seven!
sentences.translation: Bekzod ilgari tushda **turardi**. Hozir ishni soat yettida **boshlaydi**!

sentences.text: Years ago people **used to** pay in cash everywhere; now most people **pay** by phone.
sentences.translation: Yillar oldin odamlar hamma joyda naqd pul bilan **to'lashardi**; hozir ko'pchilik telefon orqali **to'laydi**.

sentences.text: Grandad **used to** be a taxi driver, but now he**'s** retired.
sentences.translation: Bobom ilgari taksi **haydovchisi edi**, hozir esa **nafaqada**.

sentences.text: Emma and I **used to** be best friends, but now we hardly ever **see** each other.
sentences.translation: Emma ikkalamiz ilgari eng yaqin **do'st edik**, hozir esa deyarli **ko'rishmaymiz**.

examples.title: Negative: **didn't use to**
examples.description: Inkor — **didn't use to** + fe'l = «ilgari ...masdi». **did** dan keyin `use` — `-d` siz.

sentences.text: I **didn't use to** like coffee, but now I drink it every day.
sentences.translation: Ilgari qahvani **yoqtirmasdim**, hozir esa har kuni ichaman.

sentences.text: Aziz **didn't use to** wear glasses.
sentences.translation: Aziz ilgari ko'zoynak **taqmasdi**.

sentences.text: This part of the city **didn't use to** be so busy.
sentences.translation: Shaharning bu qismi ilgari bunchalik **gavjum emas edi**.

sentences.text: My parents **didn't use to** have a car, so we travelled everywhere by bus.
sentences.translation: Ota-onamning ilgari **mashinasi yo'q edi**, shuning uchun hamma joyga avtobusda borardik.

sentences.text: We **didn't use to** eat out much — restaurants were too expensive for us.
sentences.translation: Ilgari tashqarida unchalik ko'p **ovqatlanmasdik** — restoranlar biz uchun juda qimmat edi.

sentences.text: Sarah **didn't use to** be interested in politics, but now she reads the news every day.
sentences.translation: Sara ilgari siyosatga **qiziqmasdi**, hozir esa har kuni yangiliklarni o'qiydi.

sentences.text: In Britain shops **didn't use to** open on Sundays.
sentences.translation: Britaniyada do'konlar ilgari yakshanba kunlari **ochilmasdi**.

sentences.text: Madina **didn't use to** speak English at all, but now she works as a translator.
sentences.translation: Madina ilgari umuman inglizcha **gapirmasdi**, hozir esa tarjimon bo'lib ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Funny — Tom **didn't use to** like cats, and now he has three!
sentences.translation: Qiziq — Tom ilgari mushuklarni **yoqtirmasdi**, hozir esa uchtasi bor!

sentences.text: Children **didn't use to** have their own phones when I was at school.
sentences.translation: Men maktabda o'qiganimda bolalarning o'z telefonlari **bo'lmasdi**.

examples.title: Questions: **Did you use to** ...?
examples.description: Savol — **Did** + ega + **use to** + fe'l? = «...armidingiz?», «...ardingiz?». Qisqa javob: Yes, I **did**. / No, he **didn't**.

sentences.text: **Did** you **use to** play any sport at school? — Yes, I **did**. I played volleyball.
sentences.translation: Maktabda biror sport turi bilan **shug'ullanarmidingiz**? — Ha. Voleybol **o'ynardim**.

sentences.text: **Did** Bekzod **use to** live in London? — No, he **didn't**. He lived in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ilgari Londonda **yasharmidi**? — Yo'q, **yashamasdi**. U Manchesterda yashardi.

sentences.text: Where **did** you **use to** go on holiday as a child? — To the mountains near Chimgan.
sentences.translation: Bolaligingizda ta'tilga qayerga **borardingiz**? — Chimyon yaqinidagi tog'larga.

sentences.text: What **did** people **use to** do in the evenings before television?
sentences.translation: Televizordan oldin odamlar kechqurunlari nima **qilishardi**?

sentences.text: **Did** your grandmother **use to** tell you stories? — Yes, every night.
sentences.translation: Buvingiz sizga ertak **aytib berarmidi**? — Ha, har kecha.

sentences.text: What time **did** you **use to** get up when you worked at the bakery? — At four!
sentences.translation: Novvoyxonada ishlaganingizda soat nechada **turardingiz**? — To'rtda!

sentences.text: Madina, **did** you **use to** have a pet? — Yes, a little white cat.
sentences.translation: Madina, ilgari uy hayvoning **bormidi**? — Ha, kichkina oq mushuk.

sentences.text: Which school **did** your children **use to** go to? — The one next to the park.
sentences.translation: Bolalaringiz qaysi maktabga **borishardi**? — Bog' yonidagisiga.

sentences.text: Who **did** you **use to** sit next to in class?
sentences.translation: Darsda kim bilan **o'tirardingiz**?

sentences.text: Excuse me, **did** this shop **use to** sell books? — Yes, but now it sells phones.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu do'kon ilgari kitob **sotarmidi**? — Ha, hozir esa telefon sotadi.

examples.title: **used to** or Past Simple?
examples.description: **used to** — o'tmishdagi takroriy odat yoki uzoq holat; bir martalik voqea va aniq necha marta bo'lgani — Past Simple. Ko'p gapda ikkalasi yonma-yon.

sentences.text: I **used to** visit Samarkand every spring. Last year I **went** there for the last time.
sentences.translation: Har bahor Samarqandga **borardim**. O'tgan yili u yerga oxirgi marta **bordim**.

sentences.text: We **used to** go to the same café every Friday, but one day it **closed**.
sentences.translation: Har juma bitta kafega **borardik**, lekin bir kuni u **yopildi**.

sentences.text: Tom **went** to Paris three times last year.
sentences.translation: Tom o'tgan yili Parijga uch marta **bordi**.

sentences.text: When Aziz was a student, he **used to** work in a café at weekends.
sentences.translation: Aziz talabaligida dam olish kunlari kafeda **ishlardi**.

sentences.text: Yesterday I **met** my old teacher in the street.
sentences.translation: Kecha ko'chada eski o'qituvchimni **uchratdim**.

sentences.text: My grandfather **used to** tell funny stories, and once he **told** us about his trip to Moscow.
sentences.translation: Bobom kulgili hikoyalar **aytib berardi**, bir marta esa Moskvaga qilgan safari haqida **gapirib berdi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **used to** play the piano for hours. She **gave** her first concert at fifteen.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza soatlab pianino **chalardi**. U birinchi konsertini o'n besh yoshida **berdi**.

sentences.text: As children, we **used to** swim in the river, and one summer we **saw** a huge fish there.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimizda daryoda **cho'milardik**, bir yozda u yerda ulkan baliq **ko'rdik**.

sentences.text: Madina **used to** take the bus to work, but last month she **bought** a car.
sentences.translation: Madina ishga avtobusda **borardi**, lekin o'tgan oy mashina **sotib oldi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **used to** be late for every lesson, but yesterday he **arrived** first!
sentences.translation: Bekzod ilgari har darsga **kechikardi**, kecha esa birinchi bo'lib **keldi**!

examples.title: Then and now: **there used to be** ...
examples.description: Joylar va odamlar o'zgaradi: **used to** va **There used to be** ... = «ilgari ... bor edi». Hozirgi holat bilan solishtirish.

sentences.text: **There used to be** a big market on this square.
sentences.translation: Bu maydonda ilgari katta bozor **bor edi**.

sentences.text: This street **used to** be full of small shops.
sentences.translation: Bu ko'cha ilgari kichik do'konlarga **to'la edi**.

sentences.text: Tashkent **used to** have only a few tall buildings.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda ilgari bir nechtagina baland bino **bor edi**.

sentences.text: Manchester **used to** be famous for its factories; now it's famous for football.
sentences.translation: Manchester ilgari zavodlari bilan **mashhur edi**, hozir esa futboli bilan mashhur.

sentences.text: **There used to be** a cinema next to our school, but it's a supermarket now.
sentences.translation: Maktabimiz yonida ilgari kinoteatr **bor edi**, hozir u supermarket.

sentences.text: People in our village **used to** know everyone's name.
sentences.translation: Qishlog'imizda ilgari odamlar hammaning ismini **bilishardi**.

sentences.text: Trains from Tashkent to Samarkand **used to** be much slower.
sentences.translation: Toshkentdan Samarqandga poyezdlar ilgari ancha **sekin yurardi**.

sentences.text: Our neighbours **used to** grow grapes in the yard, and we **used to** help them in autumn.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz hovlida uzum **yetishtirishardi**, kuzda biz ularga **yordam berardik**.

sentences.text: Before smartphones, tourists **used to** carry big paper maps.
sentences.translation: Smartfonlardan oldin sayyohlar katta qog'oz xaritalar **olib yurishardi**.

sentences.text: Where's the old bakery? — I don't know. It **used to** be here, on the corner.
sentences.translation: Eski novvoyxona qayerda? — Bilmayman. Ilgari shu yerda, burchakda **edi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: Grandad's childhood
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: Madina bobosidan bolaligi haqida so'raydi — **used to**, **didn't use to**, **Did you use to** ...? va qisqa javoblar.

sentences.text: — Grandad, what **did** you **use to** do after school when you were young?
sentences.translation: — Bobojon, yoshligingizda darsdan keyin nima **qilardingiz**?

sentences.text: — Well, I **used to** help my father in the fields.
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, dalada dadamga **yordam berardim**.

sentences.text: — **Did** you **use to** have a TV at home?
sentences.translation: — Uyingizda televizor **bormidi**?

sentences.text: — No, we **didn't**. We **used to** listen to the radio in the evenings.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, **yo'q edi**. Kechqurunlari radio **tinglardik**.

sentences.text: — And what **did** you and your friends **use to** play?
sentences.translation: — Do'stlaringiz bilan nima **o'ynardingiz**?

sentences.text: — Football, of course! We **used to** play in the street until it got dark.
sentences.translation: — Futbol, albatta! Qorong'i tushguncha ko'chada **o'ynardik**.

sentences.text: — **Did** Grandma **use to** live in the same village?
sentences.translation: — Buvim ham shu qishloqda **yasharmidilar**?

sentences.text: — No, she **used to** live in Bukhara. We met at university.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, u Buxoroda **yashardi**. Universitetda tanishganmiz.

sentences.text: — I think life **used to** be much harder in those days.
sentences.translation: — Menimcha, u paytlarda hayot ancha **og'ir edi**.

sentences.text: — In some ways, yes. But people **used to** visit each other much more often!
sentences.translation: — Ba'zi jihatdan, ha. Lekin odamlar bir-birinikiga ancha tez-tez **borishardi**!
